answer: Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the sparrow queue while genuine members promoted earlier still earns. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1405 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the terrace. The karst index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A farm of 127 pays that 207 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
